title: Max Slate Einstein: bounded, evidence-aware educational character engine (research prototype)
description:
Max Slate Einstein is an offline-first Python prototype of a bounded character engine for an Einstein-inspired educational avatar. It prefers a small, deterministic, policy-bounded response over unsupported elaboration.

It separates persona policy, local source-linked knowledge records, session memory policy, routing and safety, and the response pipeline. Historical questions go to an evidence-conscious fallback, quote-attribution questions to a quote check (VERIFIED, DISPUTED or UNSOURCED), unsafe and professional-advice requests to refusal, and topics after 1955 or modern technology to an educator mode.

Scope: an educational simulation. It does not claim that Albert Einstein speaks through it, nor sentience, autonomy or historical authenticity. It is not medical, legal, financial or safety-critical software, it uses no remote model, and long-term memory is disabled by default. Synthetic tests establish deterministic software behaviour only; no independent human, historical or security evaluation has been performed.

Python 3.11-3.12, no runtime dependencies. 37 pytest tests plus ruff and compile checks run in GitHub Actions. License: MIT.
